title: Choose the visual world (Clean & Modern)
question: Here are 4 fresh, non-sci-fi directions for the macro tracker. Which vibe feels right?

options.label: Minimalist Ledger
options.lineage: Physical paper receipts and clean notebooks
options.thesis: A stripped-back, high-contrast digital notebook that puts data first.
options.viewport: Clean black text on an off-white background, separated by thin, precise hairline rules. Strictly utilitarian but elegant.

options.label: Soft Wellness
options.thesis: A calm, forgiving interface that feels less like an instrument and more like a gentle habit.
options.viewport: Warm oat backgrounds, soft drop shadows, deeply rounded pill shapes, and muted sage green accents.

options.label: Modern Glassy
options.thesis: Premium modern aesthetics that feel native, fluid, and deeply integrated.
options.viewport: Translucent frosted glass layers floating over subtle dark gradient backgrounds with vivid, glowing macro rings.

options.label: Editorial Print
options.thesis: High-end editorial design prioritizing sharp typography and extreme whitespace.
options.viewport: Massive, elegant serif numbers for macros against a stark white background, anchored by a strict structural grid.
